node.title: What is L?
node.author: RichardJActon
node.doctext:
I've been reading the [mod://File::Temp] documentation and there are a number of places in the text where something called 'L' is alluded to, it appears several times in the see also: (https://perldoc.perl.org/5.8.8/File/Temp.html#SEE-ALSO) does anyone know what this mysterious 'L' is, and assuming this is not some kind of bug, where I can find out more about it? as my google-foo is coming up blank with nothing but Perl and the letter L to work with.
What is true is already so. Owning up to it doesn't make it worse. - Eugene Gendlin
